newsitem.title: USA: Wireless companies plan digital joint venture -WSJ.
newsitem.headline: Wireless companies plan digital joint venture -WSJ.

text.p: A group of seven wireless telephone companies in Canada and the United States plan to announce a deal designed to allow them to jointly market digital wireless phone service under the new brand name of GSM Alliance, The Wall Street Journal said.

In Thursday's electronic edition, the paper cites "people familiar with the plan" who say the alliance would create a national network of carriers using a digital transmission standard known as GSM, or global system for mobile communications, as well as uniform rates for their customers.

The article said the GSM Alliance includes Pacific Bell Mobile Services, a unit of SBC Communications Inc ; Aerial Communications Inc ; Omnipoint Corp ; Western Wireless Corp ; Powertel Inc ; Microcell Telecommunications Inc; and Bell South Mobility Inc.
